svg.title: Where the human trial evidence for DMSO actually is
svg.desc: PubMed records tagged as randomized controlled trials that mention DMSO: 169. Hand-read, 35 tested DMSO itself as a treatment in people: bladder 7, joint tendon and nerve pain 9, skin and wounds 5, gut disease and cancer survival 14 (all from one author), ALS 0. ClinicalTrials.gov: 183 studies mention DMSO; 8 test DMSO alone as a treatment, 6 of them for the bladder; 0 for ALS; none of the 8 has posted results.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 183 registered studies mention DMSO. Most use it to freeze cells or dissolve another drug.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 8 test DMSO alone as a treatment: 6 for the bladder, 1 breast implant scarring, 1 orthodontic.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 0 for ALS, 0 for arthritis, 0 for cancer on its own. None of the 8 has posted results.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Skin-cancer trials mix DMSO with 30% vitamin C, so they can't say what DMSO alone does.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Source: Jabbit hand review of PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov, Oct 19, 2026 (data file linked on the page).
